mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.recharge_no, r.member_id, r.principal_amount, r.gift_amount, r.gift_source, r.gift_frozen, r.pay_method, r.remark, r.create_time, m.name AS member_name, m.phone AS member_phone, s.name AS store_name, a.name AS activity_name, u.nickname AS operator_name FROM salon_recharge_order r LEFT JOIN salon_member m ON m.id = r.member_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN salon_store s ON s.id = r.store_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN salon_recharge_activity a ON a.id = r.activity_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.operator_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.id = #{id}
